account: It is day 0, 09:00. I have come from home to town hall and read the secretary's appointment book. Today I am due at the plaza at 10:00, home for lunch at noon, in the office for accounts at 13:00, at a dockside cottage on the east bank for tea with the neighbour at 15:00, back in the office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. Tomorrow includes a mill grain inspection. So far I have seen nothing clearly unusual: the secretary is beside me holding a writable book, and several townsfolk have passed near the hall. I asked the secretary about correspondence and unusual business but have heard no reply yet. I have a prior feeling that something is happening without my knowledge, but no evidence yet identifies any activity, participants, or purpose. The scheduled dockside tea may be a chance to hear local news, not evidence of anything suspicious.
